title: Frontend: Milestone completion confetti animation
description: Show a confetti celebration animation when a milestone is marked complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Confetti animation fires on milestone completion
Works on both desktop and mobile

steps.details: Create src/hooks/useConfetti.ts. Export function fireConfetti(): void. Call confetti({ particleCount: 100, spread: 70, origin: { y: 0.6 } }). Export the hook.
In MilestoneItem, after the complete API call succeeds, call fireConfetti().
Complete a milestone — verify confetti fires. Verify it doesn't interfere with clicking other elements.
